steps.hint: Each pane is the same Settings popup (modelled on Remote Access), drawn with the app's real parts. Scroll inside it; try a dark theme and Meadow Mist.
steps.headline: Where should a setting's control go: below its title, beside it, or depending on size?
steps.notice: Today the app does this five different ways, often inside one window (Assistant settings).

variants.label: Always below
variants.summary: Title and hint, then the control on its own line — every setting.

variants.label: Always beside
variants.summary: Title and hint left, control right — every setting.

variants.label: By control size
variants.summary: Switches beside; text boxes and choices below.

steps.path: A setting with five choices (Keep awake)
steps.headline: How should a setting with several choices be offered?
steps.notice: Look at "Keep awake". Today this exact setting is a five-part strip, though the app's own rule says strips stop at four.

variants.label: Switch strip
variants.summary: All choices side by side in one strip.

variants.label: Dropdown
variants.summary: One box that opens a list.

steps.headline: Should a group of settings sit in a box inside a box, or flat?
steps.notice: Look at "Backups" at the bottom. Today Backup & Sync uses four box styles, one inside another.

variants.label: Boxes in a box
variants.summary: An outer card holding inner cards and a dashed add button — today's shape.

variants.label: Flat
variants.summary: A small label, the rows directly under it, then a normal button.

steps.headline: How much space between groups in a Settings popup?
steps.notice: Look at the gaps between Access, This computer and Backups.
